scope: Read-only post-inference diagnostics of explicitly registered quality_evaluation runs in completed primary and comparison campaigns
unit: Unique evaluation review; first successful response by request start order, identical to monitoring deduplication
views: all unique attempted reviews with never-successful delivery treated as empty prediction
pair_false_positive_partition: Predicted pair whose aspect is absent from gold aspects
Predicted pair whose aspect exists in gold but whose sentiment is incorrect or extra
pair_false_negative_partition: Gold pair whose aspect was not detected
Gold pair whose aspect was detected but whose sentiment is missing or incorrect
invariants: For every view and scope, the two FP components sum exactly to existing end-to-end pair FP and the two FN components sum exactly to existing end-to-end pair FN

conditional_sentiment.population: Only aspect instances in predicted-aspect intersection gold-aspect, aggregated by unique review and aspect
metrics: reviews with at least one correctly detected aspect
conditional_sentiment.limitation: Missed and falsely detected aspects are excluded, so this conditional result cannot replace end-to-end quality or establish the benefit of a different pipeline

reporting: Aggregate counts and metrics only, with coverage, failure-view semantics and no sample IDs, original text or machine paths. Existing validation replay remains non-blind. This descriptive decomposition does not make causal or significance claims.
